_comment: Architecture glossary - common terms and definitions
_instructions: Add organizational terms, acronyms, and definitions here

API Gateway.definition: A server that acts as an API front-end, receives API requests, enforces throttling and security policies, passes requests to the back-end service and then passes the response back to the requester

Microservices.definition: An architectural style that structures an application as a collection of loosely coupled services, which implement business capabilities

CI/CD.definition: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment - automated practices for integrating code changes and deploying to production

OAuth 2.0.definition: An authorization framework that enables applications to obtain limited access to user accounts on an HTTP service

Event-Driven Architecture.definition: An architecture pattern in which decoupled applications asynchronously exchange messages through an event broker
